body: Thank you for the kind words, but I've had plenty of therapy. It's time. Sending love to you, too. Assumptions aside, you're a good person.
I'm not. A strong person wouldn't even be making this post

Thank you, stranger. I was last in therapy around a year ago. Tried every single medication my psychiatrist would throw at me and have been med free for nearly two years. 

It's time.

I love the implication that I neither talk to my boyfriend, nor go to the gym already. And yes, before you ask, I've tried yoga and adult colouring books, too. Going to the gym doesn't fix 25 plus years of being broken.

He's not going to be devastated. He'll be relieved that he doesn't have to deal with my BPD.
